Native scope

iOS Today

Only Today is drawn. The native stage remains incomplete; web motion coverage does not imply a finished native app.

The record never moves and the header never arrives. Dates, product-authored lines, waveforms and the composer carry load motion. Notes move only when disclosed. Account and data states remain still except for established control feedback.
